description: Record the baseline before changes. Run the project checks on the current shared checkout so that later failures can be separated from failures that already exist. Do not change any repository file.
steps: From the repository root C:\Users\minisforum-zach\Documents\global.sct, run `git status --short` and save the list in findings.
Run `bun run check` and record pass or fail with the first errors.
Run `bun run test` and record pass, fail, and skip counts.
Run `bun run typecheck:tsc` and record the result.
Run `bun run build` and record the result (this also produces out/ for the Playwright tests).
Run `bun run react-doctor` and record the score and any errors.
From tests/, run `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts platform.spec.ts` and record the result.
From tests/, run `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts theme.spec.ts` (this file exists from the canceled run) and record the result.
acceptance_criteria: findings lists the git status and the result of each command
No repository file changed (except this feature file)
verification: cd tests; bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts platform.spec.ts

findings.environment_issue: The agent shell inherits ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 from the host Electron app. With it, electron.exe runs as plain Node and tests/electron-entry.cjs fails with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading setPath)' at line 3, which Playwright reports as 'Process failed to launch!'. Fix: run `Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` in the same PowerShell command before every Playwright test or screenshot script. This change applies only to that process.
